# Hash-pinned zizmor install for both halves of the split workflow,
# .github/workflows/actionlint.yml and actionlint-pr.yml (issue 1090):
#   pip install --require-hashes -r .github/requirements-zizmor.txt
#
# zizmor==1.30.1 has no transitive dependencies on PyPI, so the file is the
# one pin. Every artifact pip could resolve for it (each published wheel
# plus the sdist) carries its sha256, so the install works on any platform
# pip could run the wheel for and still fails closed on an unexpected file.
# What fails closed means here: the gate rejects downloaded content that
# matches no allowed hash, not a typo'd hash of a real artifact — pip
# pre-filters candidates by the index's #sha256= fragment, so a corrupted
# allowed-hash entry narrows the candidate set instead of failing the install.
#
# Regenerate by hand when bumping zizmor. Take the hashes from the index's own
# record for the new version — one GET, and every artifact it published:
#   curl -s https://pypi.org/pypi/zizmor/<version>/json \
#     | jq -r '.urls[] | "--hash=sha256:" + .digests.sha256'
# then write `zizmor==<version>` followed by those values, joined onto ONE line
# with single spaces, as committed here. The set is exactly the "every artifact
# pip could resolve" claim above: each wheel plus the sdist, no more.
#
# Not pip-compile. `pip-compile --generate-hashes` emits hashes for the
# PLATFORM IT RUNS ON, so regenerating on one machine silently drops the other
# platforms' wheels and narrows the install to whichever runner happened to
# author the bump. The index's JSON record is platform-independent by
# construction, which is what this file's header actually promises.
#
# Two gates keep a bump honest, and neither is this file:
#   - pr-suite.yml runs `pip download --no-deps --require-hashes` against THIS
#     file on the pull request, so a version paired with another release's
#     hashes fails before the merge (issue 1094).
#   - actionlint.yml installs this file with the same flag.
zizmor==1.30.1 --hash=sha256:06e039fae8e185e2a1a8b002f2d95a6f5c3b548048bdd79e004dcb501fcd0868 --hash=sha256:15679642e8c4f825ba3f22537c698b1bbbad19ead23640f62ec45ebbe7abc803 --hash=sha256:17fda74e15fe41a6aa354ea4cf71fc7ff3cd025cda6584bb6d7466b3f1d00fe6 --hash=sha256:42512bb4a1bce4c787d221d1572ff6b691fa52a3d129b2910be8afaf860c5871 --hash=sha256:4a5ef2fa4fbd2984f794cfc2f95790bd03fa0bae801487ed550e044675874e60 --hash=sha256:5e8a3d54c3d9d51307371f4d1d49f8f9e56de00205c6cc660c6846a95ad4e135 --hash=sha256:92906f448365672ebb657fb50d36f997290a3aaba8cac723214741ea9054845d --hash=sha256:bf63099a27ef3bf1329dbab44bb9d1027124855c71bd0eca864d5c8e1c5c0db1 --hash=sha256:cbb7e5cb2fec471066d5c326bcaa69ed3eefdcf6a76d7ad38335b924acf86c07 --hash=sha256:eee12266b793cb87ad4a7e3af2e72404f8a63e3de5eb099b80bf7b1cfd232a8e --hash=sha256:f9eb092f089e35fa9fb3b70aeec0a19eca7dacf2ab161f1d50b18351895f085c
